title: Congress Day 1 - Victoria
description: R. John encounters Victoria, influencer/activist, at the party congress.

nodes.text: Victoria is live-streaming near the congress entrance. She's 31, polished, image-conscious. She spots you and ends the stream. 'Senator! Perfect timing.'
Victoria: 'Behind-the-scenes content. My followers love political drama.' She smiles. 'Want to make a cameo?'

choices.text: Ask what kind of content she makes

nodes.text: Victoria: 'Thank you! I always make an impact wherever I go.' She poses slightly. 'Good lighting helps.'
Victoria: 'I'm here for the women's rights panel. But honestly?' She lowers her voice. 'The real change happens behind closed doors.'

choices.text: Agree and suggest a private discussion

nodes.text: Victoria: 'Interesting.' She steps closer. 'I do have a private channel. Exclusive content for... select viewers.'
Victoria: 'Lifestyle, politics, and... exclusive interviews.' She smirks. 'The kind that don't make it to mainstream media.'
Victoria: 'I know my angles.' She shows you her phone. 'Want to see my best shots?'
Victoria: 'Even better. But find somewhere with good light. The VIP lounge has perfect lighting.'
Victoria: 'Let's just say I know people who know people. And I keep their secrets.' She holds your gaze.

choices.text: Say he has secrets worth keeping
Ask what she charges for discretion

nodes.text: Victoria: 'I was hoping you'd say that. My hotel room has better acoustics. Room 305.'
Victoria: 'It's invite-only. But...' She scans a QR code on her phone. 'Consider yourself invited.'

choices.text: Thank her and ask about meeting in person

nodes.text: Victoria: 'Now you're speaking my language. I do private sessions. Very exclusive.'
Victoria: 'That could be arranged. But exclusivity comes at a price.' She smiles.

choices.text: Ask what she has in mind

nodes.text: Victoria: 'Brand partnerships, mostly. But I'm looking for... political collaborations.' She touches your arm.
Victoria shows you her portfolio. Some photos are... revealing. 'These are from my boudoir series. Art, obviously.'

choices.text: Ask if she does private shoots

nodes.text: Victoria: 'Even better.' She checks her watch. 'I have 20 minutes before the next panel. Your place or mine?'
Victoria: 'I bet you do.' She hands you a card. 'My private line. Use it wisely.'

choices.text: Take the card and thank her

nodes.text: Victoria: 'Depends on the secret. And the client.' She smiles. 'But for you? Special rates.'
Victoria: 'Come around 10. Bring wine. And your camera.' She winks.
Victoria: 'Check your messages. I just sent you the link. And... my address.'
Victoria: 'Even better. My place tonight. I'll text you the address.'
Victoria: '€5k per session. But for you? Let's say... favors exchanged.'
Victoria: 'Good answer. My studio. Tonight. 11 PM. Don't be late.'
Victoria: 'A photoshoot. Just us. For my 'political allies' series.'
Victoria: 'Perfect. Let's discuss details. My hotel, 9 PM.'
Victoria: 'Thank you! I need a male subject for my next series. Interested?'
Victoria: 'Only for serious clients. Are you serious, Senator?'
You make your choice. Victoria smiles. 'Excellent. Let's go.'
Victoria: 'Call me when you're ready to talk. Really talk.'
Victoria: 'We'll negotiate in person. My suite. Midnight.'

endings.hotel_room_vic: Victoria invited you to her hotel room. High risk, high reward.
endings.private_invite: Private channel access granted. Moderate risk.
endings.quick_encounter: Quick encounter proposed. Very high risk.
endings.chapter_4_victoria_complete: Chapter 4 Victoria storyline complete. Social media exposure risk elevated.
